[[Category:Transformer]]
In a [[Transformer]], '''residual connection''' is the process of enriching a input [[token (machine learning)|token sequence]] with additional information derived from calculation (e.g., from [[self-attention]]).

<ref>{{#cite:Q3130}}{{#cite:Q3269}}</ref>

== Definition ==

Let $\mathbf{X}\in\mathbb{R}^{T\times d}$ be the input of a sub-layer, and let $\operatorname{SL}\in\mathbb{R}^{T\times d}$ be the '''residual''' computed by the sub-layer.

Then the '''residual connection'''

$$
\operatorname{Res}(\mathbf{X})=\mathbf{X}+\operatorname{SL}(\mathbf{X}).
$$

== Identity ==


With $\operatorname{SL}\equiv\mathbf{0}$,

$$
\operatorname{Res}(\mathbf{X})=\mathbf{X}
$$

Therefore, additional '''residual connection''' steps in a model architecture, even possibly inefficient, should not hinder model quality.<ref>{{#cite:Q3269}}</ref>
